Helper/conftest discovery expansion and helper isolation are assigned to authorized downstream task scope (BFF-ROUTER-USECASE-CORRECTIVE-001) as this parent rollup's artifact contract is strictly limited to evidence.json under REPARTITION-PLAN-002.

forensic_gap_audit_reconciliation.reconciliation_summary: Reconciliation following PR #5714 rejection and execution of REPARTITION-PLAN-002 child batches CB01-CB10. Across batches CB01-CB10, test suites were systematically decoupled from the main composition root, resulting in progressive ceiling reductions from 86 -> 73 (CB01) -> 66 (CB04) -> 30 (CB07) -> 24 (CB10) -> 11 (CB06). The live AST scan on dev tip (8025bd83a) confirms exactly 11 non-whitelisted main importers, matching the enforced ceiling of 11. All 8 tests in test_bff_test_architecture.py pass on dev. Analysis of residual importers reveals 2 composition suites independently justified and 9 application suites blocked by unextracted production seams in main.py. In test_bff_mgmt_common_filters.py, read_store monkeypatching cannot be excised without extracting production seams or modifying main.py (prohibited by repo rules). Gate discovery hardening and helper cleanup are routed through downstream authorized scope (BFF-ROUTER-USECASE-CORRECTIVE-001) preserving the parent task's evidence-only contract.
